why: p05's dark bittersweet loop lands hard when the drums and bass come in at 0:10 and breathes at the 2:55 drum dropout, while p35 is a calm, pretty, study-music-like drumless loop that only swells gently to its 2:12 high point.

p02 bursts open from its muffled start at 0:37 and has a darker breakdown with a real sliding tune at 1:21, while p32 circles the same bright, bleepy Am-F game loop with near-copy choruses from 0:38 on.

p33 drops in with a +15 dB arrival at 0:11 and floats through a drumless breakdown at 0:57 before a brighter peak at 2:16, while p05 is moody but runs one loop flat from 0:21 to 2:55 before its only break.

p03 is a moody late-night beat whose drums thump in after the muffled intro at 0:13 and takes a darker detour at 1:03, while p32 is bright, bleepy video-game music that keeps circling two chords after the drums enter at 0:38.

p04's wistful, melancholy loop gets a solid 7 dB beat drop at 0:21, which suits this listener's mood better than p32's bright game arpeggios, even though p32 has more build-and-drop motion, such as its break at 1:02.

p05's bittersweet late-night loop pulls you in and breathes at the 2:55 drum dropout, while p34's sinister, relentless riff barely lets up and never thins out, even through its heavier C-minor shift at 1:08.

p33 is dreamy and immersive, with a big arrival at 0:11 and floating drumless breakdowns at 0:57 and 1:53, while p04 drops its beat well at 0:21 but then spins one melancholy four-bar loop with nothing new after that.

p31 moves from a drumless intro to a drums-only break at 0:11 and then crashes in with a yearning full band at 0:27, while p03 is moody but stays at one level after the drums enter at 0:13, apart from its 2:02 breakdown.
p03's moody, nodding beat opens up from its filtered intro at 0:13 and eases off in the 2:02 breakdown, while p34's uneasy flat-II riff pounds on at one loudness with no breakdown at all.

p01 is a warm, moody beat with a satisfying turn at the end of each cycle, starting at 0:20, even though it never builds, while p34 has a heavy climax at 1:31 but gets there through sinister, relentless riffing that never breathes.
p33's all-at-once drop at 0:11 and floating drumless stretch at 0:57 make it more immersive than p03, which has a nice muffled-to-open start at 0:13 but then stays at one flat level.

p33 is dreamy and hypnotic, with a big arrival at 0:11 and a floating breakdown at 0:57, while p02's filter opening at 0:37 is exciting but leads into an energetic game-style loop that stays at full tilt.
p04 is a wistful head-nodding loop with a 7 dB beat drop at 0:21 and dropouts at 1:04 and 2:05, while p34 is dark in a tense, sinister way and its riff never lets up.
p31 goes from its drum break at 0:11 into a crashing full band at 0:27 and a thinned-out breather at 1:15, while p04 drops its beat at 0:21 and then repeats one progression for the rest of the track.

p01's dusty, moody chords and the dark turn that ends each cycle after 0:20 fit this listener better than p32's bright bleepy game loop, though p32 has more motion with its drum entry at 0:38 and breakdown at 1:25.
p31 has a real arrival, as the band crashes in after the solo drum break at 0:27, and it breathes in the 1:15 lull, while p01 plays the same half-minute loop three times from 0:20 with no change.
p31's drums-only break and full-band crash at 0:27, with chords that move every bar, beat p05, whose dark loop is equally moody but runs flat from 0:21 until its only break at 2:55.
p03 is moody and late-night, and its drums thump in after the filtered intro at 0:13, while p35 is calm, pretty study-music texture whose only lift is a gentle swell at 2:12.
p31 is dark and immersive, with a drum-break reveal at 0:11 and a full-band arrival at 0:27, while p02 has a good filter opening at 0:37 but then mostly stays at one energetic game-synth level.
p33 pulls you in with a big drop at 0:11, drumless floating at 0:57 and a brighter peak at 2:16, while p01 repeats one short cycle three times from 0:20 and fades before anything develops.
p04's wistful beat lands with a 7 dB jump at 0:21, while p35 stays gentle and pretty, circling the same few chords for nearly four minutes apart from the soft swell at 2:12.
p02 opens from its muffled start at 0:37 and has a darker, singing breakdown at 1:21, while p35 is calm, pretty, study-music-like texture whose only lift is a gentle swell around 2:12.
p02 has a real arrival when its filter opens at 0:37 and a breathing breakdown at 1:21, while p34's sinister riff pounds on at one level, even through the heavier C-minor section at 1:08.
p05's dark, bittersweet loop lands when the drums come in at 0:10 and breathes at the 2:55 dropout, while p32's bright, bleepy two-chord game loop feels like it's just waiting to restart.
